variants.reactive: The production detector/kernel is evaluated only after an explicit user invocation flag.
variants.heuristic: The production deterministic gap assessor is evaluated without policy, budget, cooldown, or persistence gates.
variants.kernel: The production WorkResumptionService and SuggestionKernel run against isolated real SQLite/provenance/capture roots.

source.implementation_identity: The evaluator records the exact local commit and dirty-state flag in every result.

known_deviations: This v1 split is a deterministic engineering fixture set, not a human-rated field corpus.
The full kernel currently uses a fixed detector score and has no learned ranker.
Latency is host-specific and measures the decision call after fixture setup, not end-to-end daemon notification latency.
Formal artifact.confirm_baseline registration is unavailable in the current Codex tool session; local reports must not be promoted as an accepted baseline while dirty or unregistered.
